description: Inspect this connection’s scope, tools and access policy. With no arguments returns the usual catalog. On the general or economy connection, optionally supply report_countries (1–10 World Bank codes) for a FREE live preview of the optional paid country comparison: population/GDP/inflation by default, or up to six selected historical indicators over ten years, aligned JSON and CSV, definitions and source evidence. Preview reports price, missing cells, availability and the exact HTTP purchase path; it never signs or pays. Existing data tools remain free. Buying requires an authorized x402 HTTP client, not just MCP. Source/schema checks are not independent factual verification.

report_countries.description: Optional free preview for these distinct World Bank country codes, e.g. FRA, DEU, ESP. General/economy connections only.

report_indicators.description: Custom historical comparison: select up to six of the 22 WDI indicators. Supply report_from and report_to together, up to ten years. Missing cells block payment.

independently_verified.description: Official-source checks are not independent factual corroboration.
